web.description:
# Agent Skill Index
## Creating Skills
### MCP Server Example (Python)
```
pip install fastmcp
```

```
from fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("My Server")

@mcp.tool()
def hello_world(name: str = "World") -> str:
    """A simple tool that says hello."""
    return f"Hello, {name}!"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    mcp.run()
```

## The big workflow skills
### Matt Pocock's skills (mattpocock/skills)
```
npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills
```

### GStack (garrytan/gstack)
```
git clone --single-branch --depth 1 https://github.com/garrytan/gstack.git ~/.claude/skills/gstack
cd ~/.claude/skills/gstack && ./setup
```

### GSD Core (open-gsd/gsd-core)
```
npx @opengsd/gsd-core@latest
```

## Framework skills and the "ships with your package" model
```
# Generate version-aware skills from your installed npm dependencies
npx -y skilld

# Library maintainers: scaffold SKILL.md files inside your own package
npx @tanstack/intent scaffold

# The universal installer used throughout this post — pattern is `npx skills add <owner/repo>`
npx skills add vercel-labs/skills
```
